badge.es: El duelista de Heartland que nunca se rinde: Yuma y Astral
badge.en: Heartland's never-give-up Duelist: Yuma and Astral

h.es: El kattobingu y la Emperor's Key (anime)

p.es: Yuma creció con sus padres Kazuma y Mira, su hermana Kari y su abuela Haru. Era un duelista flojo, se burlaban de su sueño de ser campeón, y su padre lo animó a no rendirse nunca. Tras un accidente en una tormenta de nieve, Yuma vio la Emperor's Key en las manos de su padre y más tarde la llevó siempre al cuello, junto con su grito de kattobingu. Cuando sus padres desaparecieron, Kari le prohibió duelear, aunque él lo hacía a escondidas, y sufría una pesadilla con una puerta demoníaca que quitaba lo más preciado.
p.en: Yuma grew up with his parents Kazuma and Mira, his sister Kari and his grandmother Haru. He was a weak Duelist, people mocked his dream of becoming champion, and his father encouraged him never to give up. After a snowstorm accident, Yuma saw the Emperor's Key in his father's hands and later always wore it around his neck, along with his kattobingu cry. When his parents went missing, Kari forbade him from Dueling, though he did it behind her back, and he suffered a nightmare about a demonic door that takes what is most precious.

p.es: Shark ganó el mazo de Bronk en un duelo con apuesta y rompió la Emperor's Key de Yuma, que lo retó para recuperarlo. En pleno duelo, Yuma abrió la puerta de sus sueños con la llave, y apareció Astral, un duelista de otro mundo que solo él ve. Shark invocó a Number 17: Leviathan Dragon, y Yuma, tras escuchar a Astral, usó Monster Reborn para traer a Gagaga Magician. Astral le dio Number 39: Utopia, que Yuma invocó con Gagaga Magician y Ganbara Knight. Con Double or Nothing! ganó el duelo.
p.en: Shark won Bronk's Deck in an Ante Duel and broke Yuma's Emperor's Key, so Yuma challenged him to win it back. Mid-Duel, Yuma opened the door from his dreams with the key, and Astral appeared, a Duelist from another world only he can see. Shark Summoned Number 17: Leviathan Dragon, and Yuma, after listening to Astral, used Monster Reborn to bring back Gagaga Magician. Astral gave him Number 39: Utopia, which Yuma Summoned with Gagaga Magician and Ganbara Knight. With Double or Nothing! he won the Duel.

p.es: Los Numbers son cartas dispersas por el mundo, y Yuma las recupera ganando duelos junto a Astral. Los Numbers amplifican las emociones de quien los lleva: el señor Kay usó Number 34: Terror-Byte para derribar la red de la escuela y quería dar felicidad con un virus virtual. Flip estafó a Yuma con una carta, Baby Tiragon, y le robó dos Numbers. Nelson, el actor del Sparrow, fue poseído por Number 83: Galaxy Queen, y Yuma lo salvó al llevar a su madre al duelo.
p.en: The Numbers are cards scattered across the world, and Yuma recovers them by winning Duels alongside Astral. The Numbers amplify the emotions of whoever carries them: Mr. Kay used Number 34: Terror-Byte to knock out the school network, and wanted to bring happiness with a virtual virus. Flip tricked Yuma with a card, Baby Tiragon, and stole two Numbers. Nelson, the actor behind the Sparrow, was possessed by Number 83: Galaxy Queen, and Yuma saved him by bringing his mother to the Duel.

p.es: Yuma llegó a las finales del World Duel Carnival y fue a la fiesta con sus amigos, aunque olvidó su invitación y Nistro lo ayudó a entrar. Vetrix interrumpió el discurso del señor Heartland y se reveló, y Kite le dijo a Yuma que en la final no quería derrotarlo a él sino a Astral. En la mañana de la final, Yuma durmió afuera del estadio para no llegar tarde. En su Duel Coaster lo acorralaron los Triad of Terror, un duelo tres contra uno. Ganó, pero le quedaron 600 Life Points.
p.en: Yuma reached the finals of the World Duel Carnival and went to the party with his friends, though he forgot his invitation and Nistro helped him get in. Vetrix interrupted Mr. Heartland's speech and revealed himself, and Kite told Yuma that in the final he wanted to defeat not Yuma but Astral. On the morning of the final, Yuma slept outside the stadium so as not to be late. On his Duel Coaster he was cornered by the Triad of Terror in a three-on-one Duel. He won, but was left with 600 Life Points.

p.es: Tras el torneo, Yuma volvió a soñar con la puerta, que le decía que alguien le quitaría lo más importante. Pensó que sería Astral. Fender, controlado por los Barians, lo retó con los Numbers en juego, y Yuma le entregó la Emperor's Key a Tori antes de ir. Fender invocó a CXyz Mechquipped Djinn Angeneral, pero Yuma recuperó la llave y, con Number C39: Utopia Ray y Numbers Impact, remontó. Después habló con Kite y Shark sobre los Barians, convencido de que juntos podían vencerlos.
p.en: After the tournament, Yuma dreamed again of the door, which told him someone would take away his most important thing. He thought it would be Astral. Fender, controlled by the Barians, challenged him with the Numbers at stake, and Yuma gave the Emperor's Key to Tori before going. Fender Summoned CXyz Mechquipped Djinn Angeneral, but Yuma got the key back and, with Number C39: Utopia Ray and Numbers Impact, made a comeback. Afterward he talked with Kite and Shark about the Barians, believing the three of them could overcome them.

p.es: Astral mostró a Yuma un mensaje de Kazuma: debían conseguir las siete Mythyrian Numbers antes que el mundo Barian. Yuma, Astral, Tori, Shark y Rio fueron a una selva, donde Yuma salvó a un chico herido llamado Nash y enfrentó a Mach, guardián de una de esas cartas. Después aparecieron los Seven Barian Emperors, con Shark y Rio como Nash y Marin. Yuma preguntó por qué debían pelear, y prometió revivir sus lazos duelando. La Emperor's Key reaccionó con la marca Barian de Nash.
p.en: Astral showed Yuma a message from Kazuma: they had to obtain the seven Mythyrian Numbers before the Barian World did. Yuma, Astral, Tori, Shark and Rio went to a jungle, where Yuma saved an injured boy named Nash and faced Mach, guardian of one of those cards. Later the Seven Barian Emperors appeared, with Shark and Rio as Nash and Marin. Yuma asked why they had to fight, and promised to revive their bonds through Dueling. The Emperor's Key reacted with Nash's Barian Emblem.

p.es: En el último duelo, Astral atacó a Yuma y le dijo que recuperara lo más importante para él. Yuma invocó a Number F0: Utopic Future con Halfway to Forever y tomó el control de Utopia Roots, pero Astral invocó a Number 99: Utopic Dragon. En el mundo de la puerta, Yuma comprendió que su cosa más importante era Astral. Dudó, pero Astral le pidió no temer el futuro sin él. Con Double or Nothing! Yuma ganó y se despidieron. Más tarde, la llave brilló: había una nueva amenaza en Astral World.
p.en: In the last Duel, Astral attacked Yuma and told him to take back what was most important to him. Yuma Summoned Number F0: Utopic Future with Halfway to Forever and took control of Utopia Roots, but Astral Summoned Number 99: Utopic Dragon. In the world of the door, Yuma understood that his most important thing was Astral. He hesitated, but Astral told him not to fear a future without him. With Double or Nothing! Yuma won and they said goodbye. Later the key glowed: there was a new threat in Astral World.
